def formula_changer(rxn, met1_id, met2_id, factor,float_ok):
    rxn_obj = model.reactions.get_by_id(rxn)
    met1_obj = model.metabolites.get_by_id(met1_id)
    met2_obj = model.metabolites.get_by_id(met2_id)
    
    met2_obj.formula = ''
    met2_obj.charge = 0
    
    coef1 = rxn_obj.metabolites[met1_obj]
    coef2 = rxn_obj.metabolites[met2_obj]
    
    rxn_obj.add_metabolites({met1_obj: coef1/factor,
                             met2_obj: coef2/factor},combine=False)
    
    imba_dict =  rxn_obj.check_mass_balance()
    print imba_dict
    if 'charge' in imba_dict.keys():
        if float_ok == 'ok':
            met2_obj.charge = -imba_dict['charge']*factor
        else:
            met2_obj.charge = -int(imba_dict['charge']*factor)
        imba_dict.pop('charge', 0)
    formula = ''
    for k,v in sorted(imba_dict.items()):
        if float_ok == 'ok':
            formula = formula + '{}{}'.format(k,abs(v*factor))
        else:
            formula = formula + '{}{}'.format(k,abs(int(v*factor)))
    met2_obj.formula = formula
    print formula
    print rxn_obj.check_mass_balance()

calculation_method.element_charge_residual_convention: sum(stoichiometric coefficient * atom count or charge), products positive
calculation_method.float_residuals: Ordinary floating-point accumulation, reproducing sensitivity of exact-zero helpers.
calculation_method.decimal_residuals: Decimal arithmetic on str() representations of SBML-loaded coefficients and element counts; no tolerance-based cancellation.
calculation_method.biomass_weight: sum(-coefficient * formula_weight)/1000; products subtract from net retained mass.
calculation_method.candidate_limits: Only one in-memory coefficient candidate was simulated; all other suggested repairs remain hypotheses requiring chemical and experimental evidence.

PFOR.interpretation: The model uses one oxidized flavodoxin (charge 0) and one reduced flavodoxin (charge -1), with identical XH formulas, for pyruvate oxidative decarboxylation. This is a candidate mismatch between a one-electron carrier convention and a two-electron substrate oxidation, not evidence for inserting a proton.
PFOR.next_step: Audit the intended flavodoxin electron capacity, substrate oxidation and MCA0769 evidence, jointly with POR_syn and every reaction sharing flxso_c/flxr_c.
PFOR.equation: coa_c + flxso_c + pyr_c --> accoa_c + co2_c + flxr_c + h_c

POR_syn.interpretation: The alternative MCA0769 pyruvate reaction consumes two fdxox_c and three protons. Both ferredoxin forms have charge 0; fdxrd_c instead adds H2 to its formula. The encoded equation is atom balanced but has charge residual -2. This mixes protonation and electron-carrier conventions.
POR_syn.next_step: Resolve ferredoxin oxidation/protonation conventions across all linked reactions and reconcile parallel MCA0769 routes; do not patch this equation independently.
POR_syn.equation: coa_c + 2.0 fdxox_c + 3.0 h_c + pyr_c --> accoa_c + co2_c + 2.0 fdxrd_c

CYP460ipp.classification: Encoded electron balance inconsistency; active bounds; enzyme-product evidence requires review
CYP460ipp.interpretation: The encoded hydroxylamine-to-nitrite conversion transfers electrons to only two cytochrome-c-555 carriers, each reduced from charge +3 to +2. That substrate/product oxidation requires four electrons, explaining the +2 residual. Historical Bath experiments reported nitrite, whereas later P460 work discusses NO intermediates and N2O; model product choice also warrants review.
CYP460ipp.next_step: Reconcile the intended net reaction, product(s), aerobic side chemistry and cytochrome electron count with organism-specific literature. Review HAORipp independently rather than making both enzymes duplicates or merely changing a proton coefficient.
CYP460ipp.equation: 2.0 ficytcc555_p + h2o_p + ham_p --> 2.0 focytcc555_p + 5.0 h_p + no2_p

HAORipp.classification: Encoded electron balance inconsistency; disabled by baseline bounds
HAORipp.interpretation: Has the same hydroxylamine/nitrite and two-cytochrome equation as CYP460ipp and the same +2 charge residual, but bounds [0,0]. This latent inconsistency matters if a later scenario activates the reaction; expression evidence does not determine its stoichiometry.
HAORipp.next_step: Audit the HAO-specific reaction, GPR and product evidence alongside CYP460ipp; retain explicit baseline disabled status until supported.
HAORipp.equation: 2.0 ficytcc555_p + h2o_p + ham_p --> 2.0 focytcc555_p + 5.0 h_p + no2_p

ACCOAC_1.classification: Encoded biotin-carrier charge convention mismatch; disabled by baseline bounds
ACCOAC_1.interpretation: The carboxybiotin and biotin carrier pseudo-species both have charge 0. Carboxyl transfer from acetyl-CoA(-4) to malonyl-CoA(-5) leaves residual -1. The paired BTNC residual is opposite, suggesting a shared modified-carrier representation issue even though the summed two-step pathway may cancel charge.
ACCOAC_1.next_step: Reconcile carboxybiotin versus biotin carrier protonation/charge consistently in both ACCOAC_1 and BTNC and other uses; check each reaction separately.
ACCOAC_1.gpr: MCA1045 or MCA1046 or MCA1804 or MCA2493

BTNC.classification: Encoded biotin-carrier charge convention mismatch; disabled by baseline bounds
BTNC.interpretation: ATP-dependent bicarbonate loading of the same charge-0 biotin carrier has residual +1, opposite ACCOAC_1. Cancellation across a pathway does not validate either individual reaction.
BTNC.next_step: Audit the shared carrier definition jointly with ACCOAC_1 before enabling this baseline-disabled route.
BTNC.equation: atp_c + btnCCP_c + hco3_c --> adp_c + cbtnCCP_c + h_c + pi_c
BTNC.gpr: MCA1046 or MCA1045 or MCA1804 or MCA2493

ASNTRAT.classification: Encoded charged-tRNA pseudo-species mismatch; disabled by baseline bounds
ASNTRAT.interpretation: The encoded aspartyl-tRNA has charge 0 and asparaginyl-tRNA has charge +1; the ATP/glutamine amidotransferase reaction has charge residual +1 while preserving its encoded atoms.
ASNTRAT.next_step: Audit aminoacyl-tRNA residue formulas, charge conventions and the intended amidation equation across linked tRNA reactions before changing protons or enabling this route.
ASNTRAT.equation: asptrna_c + atp_c + gln__L_c + h2o_c --> adp_c + asntrna_c + glu__L_c + 2.0 h_c + pi_c

MC_Average_FattyAcid.classification: Exact small charge discrepancy plus major elemental unit defect
MC_Average_FattyAcid.interpretation: Eight fatty-acid reactant weights sum to 0.999, all with charge -1; product coefficient 1 and charge -1 yield exact -0.001 charge. The much larger atom mismatch arises from the 1000-fold formula conversion. Changing the product coefficient to 0.001 alone instead gives +0.998 charge.
MC_Average_FattyAcid.next_step: Resolve mixture normalization, pseudo-unit formula scale and charge scale jointly, propagating consistent definitions to downstream lipid synthesis and biomass.
MC_Average_FattyAcid.equation: 0.092 cpoa2h_c + 0.729 hdca_c + 0.089 hpdca_c + 0.004 ocdca_c + 0.007 ocdcea_c + 0.01 ptdca_c + 0.061 ttdca_c + 0.007 ttdcea_c <=> mc_fattyacid_c

G3PAT_MCi.classification: Exact 0.001 pseudo-lipid charge discrepancy; active bounds
G3PAT_MCi.interpretation: The integer-scaled fatty-acyl-CoA pseudo-metabolite has charge -3001 and is consumed with coefficient 0.001. The glycerol-phosphate acyltransferase equation has exact +0.001 charge; its atom residuals are only floating-point noise. This is consistent with the notebook conversion/truncation problem, not a missing-formula problem.
G3PAT_MCi.next_step: Audit all scaled lipid formulas and charges as a coupled representation; do not hide the exact charge discrepancy with an overly loose tolerance.

APG3PAT_MCi.classification: Exact 0.001 pseudo-lipid charge discrepancy; active bounds
APG3PAT_MCi.interpretation: The second acyltransferase similarly consumes 0.001 of the charge -3001 acyl-CoA pseudo-metabolite and has exact +0.001 charge. Its apparent atom imbalance is numerical only.
APG3PAT_MCi.next_step: Audit jointly with MC_Average_FattyAcid, MC_AFAA and G3PAT_MCi, maintaining consistent charge per encoded pseudo-unit.

MC_AFAA.interpretation: The encoded charge sum is exactly zero under decimal recomputation; floating arithmetic gives -4.44e-16. This specific failure is not evidence for changing its chemistry, although the shared lipid representation still needs network-wide review.
MC_AFAA.next_step: Retain the raw MEMOTE result and classify this residual as numerical with a declared supplementary tolerance or exact-decimal check.
